definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize a clear difference or superiority in comparisons. Indicates that something stands out significantly above alternatives.
With firm determination, in a decided manner. Similar to 断固 but less formal.

examples.japanese: こっちの{方|ほう}が{断然|だんぜん}おいしい。
examples.english: This one is far more delicious.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{方|ほう}が{断然|だんぜん}{速|はや}い。
{去年|きょねん}より{断然|だんぜん}{成績|せいせき}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: My grades improved dramatically compared to last year.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{断然|だんぜん}{反対|はんたい}した。
{周囲|しゅうい}の{反対|はんたい}にもかかわらず、{彼|かれ}は{断然|だんぜん}{自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{貫|つらぬ}いた。
examples.english: Despite the opposition around him, he resolutely stuck to his opinion.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the more common modern usage, functioning as an emphatic intensifier in comparisons: X の{方|ほう}が{断然|だんぜん}... (X is far more...). Sense 2 overlaps with {断固|だんこ} but is less formal.

POSITION:
Typically appears directly before the adjective or verb it modifies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断然|だんぜん}{違|ちが}う: completely different
- {断然|だんぜん}いい: far better
- {断然|だんぜん}トップ: by far the top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ずっと: much more, by far (casual)
- {断然|だんぜん}: definitely, by far (emphatic)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}に: overwhelmingly (more formal)
